centralIntegration: Contract and vectors are ready locally; central Wallet registry, App Gateway routes and owner acceptance are not deployed or verified.
knownLimitations: Fresh authoritative Testnet payment, two-account Split flow, sponsorship receipt and refund proof are blocked on accepted central Gateway/Testnet deployment.
No current source-bound Android/iOS install and cold-launch evidence.
No public service URL, hosted immutable artifact, production signature or store release.

Local fixture migration, backup, restore, rollback and corruption recovery are verified; production-volume RTO/RPO and remote backup retention remain incomplete.
Observability and a 1,000-request local loopback capacity gate are tested, but deployed dashboards/alerts, staging workload capacity and invoice-backed unit economics remain incomplete.
Web/PWA export and functional keyboard/RTL/390px checks pass; complete dark-theme, 200% large-text and manual screen-reader acceptance remain incomplete.
Stablecoin and Bridge production-capable providers remain unavailable until approved owner/provider contracts exist.
